historical_references.reference: Ibn Khaldun's 'Al-'Ibar', Chapter 3, The Berbers and their Realms. Arshan mentioned as a vassal of the Marinids.
historical_references.context: Arshan was a vassal ruler of the Marinid Empire in Morocco during the 14th century. He was a Berber leader and held a significant amount of power and territory under the Marinids.

historical_references.reference: Al-Maqrizi's 'Al-Mawāʾīz wa l-īʿṭāz', Volume 2, Page 259. Arshan mentioned as a governor of Qayrawan under the Hafsids.
historical_references.context: Arshan was also a governor of Qayrawan under the Hafsid Empire in Tunisia during the 14th century. He held a prominent position in the administration and governed the city on behalf of the Hafsids.
